topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I received the message with a quiet acceptance, almost as if I had anticipated it all along. The surprise party, a carefully orchestrated event to celebrate me, was no more. It seems some guests couldn’t make it, and the joy of the unexpected gathering dimmed under the weight of unexpected absences. I responded with a simple, understated thanks, acknowledging the effort despite the outcome. The world, I’ve noticed, is often a series of plans and their subsequent unravellings. Today, I am simply another thread in the tapestry, untangled and rewoven into a new pattern.
